prose.subject: Invoice INV-52374 - Kestrel Media to Greywater Robotics
prose.body:
Dear Greywater Robotics Team,

Please find attached Invoice INV-52374 for services rendered in the current billing cycle. We appreciate your continued partnership and trust that the work completed meets your expectations.

**Invoice Details:**
Invoice Number: INV-52374
Date Issued: October 15, 2023
Payment Due: November 14, 2023

**Line Items:**
1. Content Strategy Consultation: $2,500.00
2. Video Production Services: $3,000.00
3. Graphic Design Assets: $1,294.23

**Total Amount Due:** 6,794.23 USDC

Please remit payment to our standard account below. Kindly reference the invoice number in your payment notes to ensure accurate reconciliation.

**Payment Address:** kestrelmedia81.testnet

Should you have any questions regarding this invoice or require further details on the line items, please do not hesitate to reach out to our accounts receivable team at billing@kestrel-media.example.

Thank you for your business.

Sincerely,

Financial Department
Kestrel Media
